messages:
maria (partnerships): quick sync — we need a lightweight intake matrix for the new SI connector program. tl;dr: who owns the lead, how do we map accounts (si-owned vs joint), and what triggers a joint announcement?
jordan (sales): do we have an example for overlapping accounts? e.g., SI submits a lead but the account already has a rdw AE. who gets notified?
sam (solutions): my proposal: if SI has an existing SOW or commercial relationship, ownership defaults to SI. otherwise route to RDW AE but CC the SI for collaboration.
elena (product): marketplace listings need the "joint_ann" flag set before we schedule joint comms. also we should require a one-pager from the SI for co-branding signoff.
chris (revops): can we codify that into an automated rule? thinking: if partner_contract=true && lead_stage>=demo -> route to si-queue; else -> rdw-ae-queue. we can implement in HubSpot.
maria (partnerships): that sounds good. can someone sketch the matrix? columns: partner_contract, account_owner, lead_source, routing, joint_announce_ok
bryn (partner-ops): I can draft the matrix. also propose a short tagging pattern so routing rules are reliable. example tag schema below:
```
si_partner: acme-sys
lead_source: si_connector
account_owner: SI|RDW
joint_ann: yes|no
```
maria (partnerships): perfect — puts the logic in a single place. can we add a small checklist for marketing approvals?
elena (product): add items: one-pager, logo SVG, joint statement draft, legal signoff if co-sell revenue share > 10%.
jordan (sales): +1 for including revshare threshold. also need an escalation path if AE and SI disagree on ownership. suggest a 48h adjudication window and then partner-ops arbiter.
chris (revops): I'll draft the HubSpot workflow and the routing rule snippets. will post the automation playbook link when done.
bryn (partner-ops): i'll put the matrix + checklist on Confluence and ping this thread when ready: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRT/pages/45512-SI+Connector+Intake
maria (partnerships): awesome. @chris @bryn can you aim to have a first pass by EOW? i'll coordinate with legal/marketing for the approval items. :thumbsup:
chris (revops): yep — aiming for Friday.
elena (product): thanks all. once we have the matrix, I'll add the joint_ann validation to the marketplace publish flow.
maria (partnerships): closing loop — bryn will post the page, chris will add automation rules, elena will wire product checks. follow-ups in Confluence. :rocket:
